speaker: Vesper
line: Tony, you’re standing there like you invented patience, but we both know waiting isn’t your style. So what are you really stalling for—conviction or cover?

speaker: Tony
line: Listen, Guest, I’m scared of two things: one, geese, full stop. One of those feathered assholes chased me ‘round Staten Island Mall like I stole its kid. Two, ending up stuck here with Chad holding that damn rose like it’s some trophy for being clueless. You think you can handle teaching someone to parallel park but can’t even handle a little noise before the vote? Nah. You’re playing it careful, but me? I’m just checking my mirrors and waiting for someone who actually deserves that rose, you know what I mean?

speaker: Tony
line: Listen, everyone’s walking on eggshells like it’s a damn minefield, but Chad’s grinning like he just parked Lorraine in a no-parking zone and got away with it. You want the truth? Tonight’s a mess disguised as calm, like somebody took the ignition keys and threw ’em in the pool. Nobody trusts a damn soul, not even the last rose sittin’ there all shiny and useless. And me? I’m just waiting for someone who can actually drive this shit forward instead of stallin’, you know what I mean?
